## Observed Facts
- **Count:** 20,217 BGL Log Entries contain "ciod" (case-insensitive substring on message). The scope is BGL, 2005-06-01 to before 2005-07-01, with no component or level filter [E1]. These are Log Entries, not incidents.
- **First match:** line 4988, 2005-06-03 16:17:40.190, node R26-M0-NC-I:J18-U11, component APP, level FATAL. The message is `ciod: Error loading /p/gb2/stella/RAPTOR/65641/raptor: invalid or missing program image, No such file or directory` [E1].
- **Just before (lines 4980–4987, 16:12–16:16):**
  - Four KERNEL INFO lines on R16-M1-N2-C:J17-U01 reported correctable errors ("CE sym 2 ..."). They ended with "total of 31 ddr error(s) detected and corrected" at 16:12:36 [E2].
  - Four KERNEL INFO "generating core.N" lines (core.257, core.385, core.65, core.1) followed at 16:16:26. They came from R22-M0 nodes [E2].
- **Just after (lines 4989–4996):**
  - Within about 255 ms, identical APP FATAL "ciod: Error loading .../raptor" lines appeared. They came from other nodes: R26-M0-NC, N8, N4 and N0 (I:J18, U01 and U11), then R27-M1-NC-I:J18-U11 [E2].
  - All the shown lines report the same program path [E2].

## Hypotheses
- The failure looks like one job launch, with the same `raptor` executable (job path .../65641/) missing or unreadable on every I/O node that tried to load it. The likely cause is a bad or absent path or filesystem mount, not a hardware fault.
- The earlier correctable DDR errors and core dumps are on different racks (R16, R22). They are probably unrelated to this load failure, though the core dumps could come from a previous job.

## Unknowns
- I haven't confirmed whether the 20,217 matches are all the same "Error loading" message or a mix of ciod messages. I only retrieved 5 sample rows and 17 context rows.
- The logs can't show whether the file actually existed, or why it was missing.
- I don't know whether the "generating core" lines belong to the same job.

## Next Step
Run `count_by` on BGL with query "ciod", the same date range, and group_by `node` or `level`. Then run it with query "Error loading", to see how many of the 20,217 matches are this error and how many nodes it hits. Also check whether the same path appears on later days, using `trend` with query "RAPTOR/65641".
